programs.description: In 1956 France, Sister Irene faces the terrifying demon Valak, racing against time to save a convent and the surrounding community from evil.

A logger and his father head to their hunting cabin, hoping for a quiet weekend. Instead, they find themselves in a kill-or-be-killed stand for survival when they encounter a gang of drug traffickers.
Undercover agent Lucas White endeavours to join Vin Serento's gang of street racers. Together, they plan to steal a large amount of money from crime kingpin Juan Carlos.

Security expert Ray Breslin forms a team of skilled personnel after escaping 'The Tomb'. However, when one of his colleagues goes missing, Breslin is forced to revisit the group that imprisoned him.
Katniss Everdeen realises that she is no longer fighting for survival. So, she sets out to assassinate the tyrannical President Snow and liberate the people of Panem.
The GI Joes are declared traitors by Zartan, with Cobra Commander now having all the world leaders under his control. With nowhere to go, the team turns to its original leader, General Colton.
After losing his job, lover and his powers, Peter Parker feels dissatisfied with his life. Soon, amidst all this chaos, he also has to fight Doctor Octavius who poses a threat to the New York.
In a world where Vikings and dragons are sworn enemies, a young Viking, Hiccup, saves and befriends a dragon, Toothless, defying generations of hatred between their species.
Van Helsing, a legendary monster hunter, is sent to Transylvania by the Vatican to kill Count Dracula and protect the last descendants of the Valerious, Anna and Velkan.
An eccentric director, Carl Denham and his crew make their way to film on the perilous Skull Island, home to several wayward creatures including a gigantic ape named Kong.
Space Marines travel to Mars to inspect a remote research base. Consequently, lethal killing machines launch a devastating ambush.
Four teens are transported into a magical jungle game, becoming adult avatars and must navigate challenges to return home safely.
When a new criminal comes to town, the Anti-Villain League seeks out Gru in order to fight him off. Despite his initial refusal, Gru eventually agrees after his aide goes back to his evil ways.

Jonas Maldonado, the son of a deceased police officer, joins the team and works alongside his father's former partner. Soon, he uncovers the truth about his father's death.
Jim Rhodes, a U.S. Border Patrol agent, stays with his rebellious daughter in the mountains of Montana. However, things go south when the father-daughter duo are kidnapped by a crew of gangsters.
Nolan Hayes faces challenges to keep Abigail, his newborn daughter who is on a ventilator, alive when Hurricane Katrina impacts the functionality and electricity of the hospital.
Jane, an American girl travelling in Hong Kong, gets into a physical altercation with three robbers where she defends herself. A martial artist, who observes the event, trains her for a competition.
Detective John Hobbes witnesses the execution of a demonic serial killer, Edgar Reese. However, questions arise when the murders start again, eerily matching the modus operandi of Reese.

An earthquake cracks open the bottom of a lake, releasing a prehistoric species of piranha. As sinister events unfold due to the flesh-eating fish, a group of strangers teams up to stop the bloodbath.
A Vietnam War veteran arrives in a small town but faces hostility from the local sheriff, leading to a tense conflict where survival instincts and combat skills take over.
An Egyptologist is caught in the crossfire when a sinister cult resurrects the mummified body of an evil priest. The group then aims to use his ancient power to defeat a legendary warrior.
Dragon Warrior Po takes it upon himself to foil the plans of murderous peacock Shen who intends to conquer China and destroy kung fu. For this, Po has to unveil the mystery of his own past.
